violated_contract: A build that compiles a third-party plugin must pin the SDK version that plugin was written against. A Gradle version range whose upper bound is the next major admits that major, so a clean tree fails the hosted compile when the vendor publishes a breaking release. pubspec.lock pins Dart packages but not Maven artifacts, so the lockfile cannot catch this drift.
canonical_prevention: Force the last compatible major on every project in the root build — a Flutter plugin resolves its own compile classpath, so the app's direct dependency cannot constrain it — and assert the pin in a static guard so the closed range cannot return.
